title: Implement Robust Error Handling Mechanism
description: A robust error handling mechanism is crucial for a production-ready framework like Yantraverse, as it ensures that errors are properly logged and handled, providing valuable insights for debugging and improvement. This feature will introduce a centralized error handling system that catches and logs errors, while also providing a fallback response to the user. By implementing this feature, Yantraverse will become more reliable and user-friendly.
testCases: Test error handling for route not found
Test error handling for server errors
acceptance: Error handling mechanism should log errors with relevant details and provide a fallback response to the user, without crashing the server
reason: Error handling is a critical aspect of a production-ready framework, and its implementation will significantly improve the overall stability and reliability of Yantraverse
